en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 3.  Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) narrates from his ancestors that Amirul  Momineen  (a.s.)  relates  that  the  Holy  Prophet (s.a.w.s.) said, “Shaitaan fears man as long as he offers five times prayer in its prime time. When the person wastes these Salaat, Shaitaan gets bold and involves that person in greater sins.”
